Paving, Surfacing, and Tamping Equipment Operators


About the Role
Operate equipment used for applying concrete, asphalt, or other materials to road beds, parking lots, or airport runways and taxiways, or for tamping gravel, dirt, or other materials. Includes concrete and asphalt paving machine operators, form tampers, tamping machine operators, and stone spreader operators.
What You'll Do
Start machine, engage clutch, and push and move levers to guide machine along forms or guidelines.
Fill tanks, hoppers, or machines with paving materials.
Control paving machines to maintain a constant flow of asphalt or other material.
Observe distribution of paving material to adjust machine settings or material flow.
Coordinate truck dumping.
Drive machines onto truck trailers and drive trucks to transport equipment and material to job sites.
Inspect, clean, maintain, and repair equipment using hand tools.
Operate machines to spread, smooth, level, or reinforce stone, concrete, or asphalt on road beds.


Tools & Technology
HCSS HeavyBid (Project management software)
Microsoft Excel (Spreadsheet software)
Education & Experience
Education: Less than high school diploma or High school diploma or equivalent
On-the-Job Training: 1 to 2 years
Related Work Experience: 1 year to 2 years
Work Environment
Outdoors, exposed to all weather conditions
Wear safety equipment
Exposed to whole body vibration
Exposed to hazardous equipment
